version: Denver Visible Human Female 2022, Final 3D STL Models
scope: Female donor VHF (NLM Visible Human Female); manual cryosection segmentation of the lower limbs, pelvis to toes; final smoothed surfaces

source_metadata.notes: Manually segmented from the NLM Visible Human Female cryosections by the University of Denver; final surfaces are smoothed and overclosure-corrected, not raw segmentation. Coordinates are the aligned VHF image frame; no other donor is mixed in this view.
